whatIsIt.eli5: A cheap pattern finder: first each layer of notes is looked at alone, then the layers are mixed.
whatIsIt.simple: A depthwise k×k conv (each channel filtered on its own) followed by a pointwise 1×1 conv (mixing channels), then BN and SiLU.
whatIsIt.engineer: Conv2d(c, c, k, s, groups=c) → Conv2d(c, c2, 1) → BN → SiLU (no BN between).

whyExists.eli5: Much cheaper than a normal pattern finder.
whyExists.simple: YOLOv13 replaces large-kernel convs with depthwise-separable blocks to save parameters and compute.
whyExists.engineer: Cost ≈ c·k² + c·c2 vs c·c2·k² per position.

example.eli5: YOLOv13n uses it to shrink 80 to 40.
example.simple: YOLOv13n layer 5: 128 channels, 80×80 → 40×40, 17,792 parameters (YOLOv8n's stride-2 Conv at layer 5 has 73,984).
